criteria.notes: The app implements one editable product TABLE plus one independently named File System image binding, deterministic matching, fallback, and bounded rotation.
No external visual reference was supplied; the creative-led result consistently follows the accepted editorial retail concept.
The field-note retail spread, serif product typography, large photography, and restrained progress marks are specific and not dashboard-like.
Product name, price, availability, and key details remain room-readable across the declared signage surfaces.
The single light editorial palette maintains strong text, badge, rule, media, and fallback contrast in every reviewed state.
Long collection, product, and description copy plus compact and portrait layouts remain contained through auto-fit, wrapping, and intentional omission.
The composition fills Full HD, wide-low, landscape, portrait, square, compact, and empty surfaces without overflow or accidental dead zones.
Synthetic product photography, package icon, placeholder, fallback illustration, and palette form a coherent upload-safe set.
Compared with maintained examples, the catalog uses a distinct retail-editorial composition and does not copy the operational dashboard language.
